summary: Nexalin Technology filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing a Distribution Agreement effective September 22, 2026, with founders of INOVANEXA MEDICAL TECHNOLOGIES S.A., a Brazilian corporation in formation. Nexalin appointed the distributor as exclusive distributor of its Nexalin Sync neurostimulation device in seven South American countries for an initial ten years, renewable. The distributor placed an initial binding order for five devices, with a clinical pilot targeted within 90 days, and minimum revenue requirements to retain exclusivity. Nexalin retains all intellectual property. This is a routine commercial distribution contract, not a special situation.
